Fluorouracil toxicity manifests as mucosal injury, myelosuppression and cutaneous toxicity. Cardiac and neurologic injury are minority manifestations.
Joint hypermobility, skin hyperextensibility and abnormal scarring define EDS; platelet dysfunction defines this subtype. Mitral prolapse frequency is unestablished.
Inherited recurrent gestational trophoblastic disease confined to the reproductive/obstetric domain; NLRP7 does not establish immune disease.
Breast carcinoma has no axis. Estrogen-receptor status does not make it an endocrine disorder; metastatic risks do not qualify.
Lymphoid-cell malignancy arising in ocular adnexa; ocular origin and haematologic lineage apply, with the required lymphoma mechanism axis.
Malignant B-lymphocyte neoplasm within the lymphoma hierarchy. No additional organ is consistently damaged across this heterogeneous group.
HADH deficiency causes disordered metabolism and hyperinsulinemic hypoglycemia. Listed hepatic, cardiac and lasting neurologic injuries lack evidence of frequency ≥30%.
Infantile-onset distal myopathy is a primary skeletal muscle disease; the neuromuscular ancestry does not establish nerve involvement.
